text:
Priya CSM: Quick QBR prep — account ORIONPRIME showing a 3x embed token usage spike this week. Can we compile a spend readout + recommended throttles by EOD? Link to dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/ACCT-ORION

Ethan Infra: saw that, likely from a nightly batch embed job. I can surface top routes and per-route token counts, will pull raw numbers now.

Lena (FinOps): can we get a 3-scenario forecast (baseline / expected / activation surge) and a suggested credits cushion? I can draft the QBR slide.

Jonas (Enablement): looping enablement to capture whether onboarding scripts changed. @Samir any training pushes or new templates this week?

Samir: we shipped the new embed batching job on Tue, may be missing batching flag in prod. Looking into logs.

billing-bot: Alert: Account ORIONPRIME crossed 75% of monthly credits. (alert id #b-4432)

Priya CSM: OK action items: 1) Ethan — top 5 endpoints + token delta by 14:00. 2) Samir — confirm batching flag or revert. 3) Lena — three-scenario slide by EOD. 4) I will own customer comms + mitigation note.

Ethan Infra: dumping quick preview (raw):
```
route,tokens_prev_week,tokens_this_week,pct_change
embed/create,120000,480000,+300% 
chat/generate,40000,45000,+12%
search/semantic,5000,5200,+4%
```

Samir: confirmed: batching=false in prod job config. Rolling a fix now, ETA ~20m.

Priya CSM: thanks. Lena — anything you need from my side to shape the slides?

Lena (FinOps): pls attach last 3 months consumption + current committed credits and renewal date. Also include worst-case uplift impact on renewal conversation.

Jonas (Enablement): we'll add a short how-to for customers about embedding best practices and recommended batching config; drafting now.

Priya CSM: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note proposing a temporary rate-limit + invite them to a mitigation call. Will post draft in #customer-comm for review. :thumbsup:

Ethan Infra: fix deployed. Tokens trending back down; will monitor for 2 hrs and report back with a follow-up snapshot.

Priya CSM: final ask: add a "cost mitigation" slide to the QBR with before/after charts and note our recommended auto-throttle + batching defaults. Assigning slide to Lena. Thanks everyone — will reconvene if billing-bot fires again.
